messages:
Maya: quick recap from this morning's pager — customer-facing 502s for ~22m, root cause was autoscaler thrash on dedicated pool. ticket: INC-5989. Posting followup ideas here so we can agree on who owns what.

Sam: thanks. can we start by scheduling the postmortem? i can host a live write if we do it today.

Maya: yes pls. my ask: 1) get postmortem scheduled 2) create action items with owners + due dates in actionboard 3) improve handoff metadata so the oncall handoff captures customer impact and mitigation steps.

Jules: +1. also want a small change to incident-bot: include a "customer-impact" enum and an auto-suggested SLT severity based on 502 rate. currently we only have "service" and "severity" free text which is messy.

Len: i can take the incident-bot changes. proposal: add fields -> customer_impact: [none, minor, major, outage], estimated_affected_pct: number, sla_flag: [yes/no]. bot will prompt at incident close.

Maya: perfect. put the schema in the post below and i'll review.

Len: here's a minimal patch i sketched for the bot command flow: 
```
/incident close --id INC-5989 --impact major --aff_pct 12 --sla_flag yes
# bot will then create postmortem draft and ping owners based on oncall roster
```

Sam: digging into scheduling: who should be on the postmortem? ops, platform, infra oncall, eng-runtime, and a product rep. i'll add product and account-sre to the invite.

Jules: for action tracking, i'd like us to try a simple actionboard with the following columns: To Do / In Progress / Blocked / Done, and fields: owner, due_date, risk_reduction (1-5), deploy_risk (low/med/high). i can prototype a template in the actionboard today.

Maya: love that. also we need a short postmortem template tweak: require a short customer-impact blurb (one sentence) at top and a clearly labelled mitigation timeline. makes triage easier for support and CS.

incident-bot: I generated a postmortem draft for INC-5989: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-5989-draft 

Maya: nice. i'll take the first pass on the timeline. Sam — can you own the remediation for autoscaler smoothing and add acceptance criteria?

Sam: yep. i'll own it. initial plan: bump stabilization window, add cooldown jitter, and add an automated circuit-breaker when thrash is detected. target: PR by EOD Tuesday, rollout to canary Wednesday.

Len: noted. i'll update the bot to add `customer_impact` and `estimated_affected_pct` to the PM draft. also planning to add a new channel for handoff summaries: #oncall-handoffs. bot will post a short JSON-ish snippet that the oncoming oncall can quickly parse.

Jules: can we make the handoff snippet human-friendly too? suggestion: one-line impact + last-known mitigation command + links. example: 

`impact:major | affected:~12% requests | mitigation: disable-autoscale --pool=dedicated-prod | tickets:INC-5989`

Len: yeah i'll add both a machine and human line. also will add a reaction-based quick-ack so the oncoming oncall can confirm with :white_check_mark:.

Maya: scheduling note — Sam, can you send calendar invite for 30m postmortem at 16:00 PST? include product and cs reps.

Sam: sending now. invite created. pinging product @product-team to confirm availability.

Maya: for tracking actions, let's use tags that the actionboard can filter by: `component:autoscaler`, `impact:customer-facing`, `pm:INC-5989`. Jules — can you add those tags to the prototype?

Jules: added. i'll share the prototype link in a sec.

ops-bot: Reminder: on-call Handoff template updated. New fields: last_15m_metrics_link, mitigation_command, customer_impact. See /handbook/oncall/handoff for examples.

Maya: nice. two last asks: 1) create a small onboarding doc for oncall rotation that explains how to mark SLA candidates in the bot, 2) add a weekly dashboard that surfaces open postmortems with overdue actions.

Len: i can draft the onboarding doc. Jules, can you add the dashboard widget? ideally shows open actions, owner, days overdue, and risk_reduction score.

Jules: yep. plan: add a dashboard card called "Postmortem Actionboard" and a heatmap for overdue items. i'll aim for a prototype by Thursday.

Sam: quick question on prioritization — how do we decide which action items must be done before reopening autoscaling? suggestion: if risk_reduction < 3 and deploy_risk high then keep autoscale off for prod.

Maya: that rule makes sense. let's add it as an acceptance checkpoint in the postmortem and a checklist in the actionboard item.

Len: i'll add a `reopen_checks` boolean and fields for `reopen_criteria` in the bot-generated postmortem.

Maya: ok, owners: Sam (autoscale remediation), Len (bot + onboarding doc), Jules (actionboard + dashboard), Maya (postmortem timeline + customer-impact blurb). target all action items with due dates within 2 weeks except the dashboard which can be 4 weeks.

Sam: noted. i'll update INC-5989 action list now.

Jules: prototype shared: https://redwood.internal/actionboard/proto/pm-actions-5989

Maya: thanks all. this is a good framework. followups: Len — post the bot schema PR link here when ready. Jules — add dashboard prototype link to the postmortem. Sam — confirm the rollout schedule in the action item. i'll close this thread after we confirm PRs. :thumbsup:

Len: PR opened: https://git.redwood/ops/incident-bot/pulls/42 (adds customer_impact + handoff snippet + quick-ack).

Sam: PR for autoscaler change will be up by EOD Tuesday: https://git.redwood/platform/autoscaler/pulls/317

Jules: dashboard prototype link added to the draft postmortem.

Maya: i'll sync with CS on a customer note and update the postmortem draft. thanks everyone.

incident-bot: Postmortem published (draft -> review): https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-5989-review
